_about: SHELF of classical Arabic prose and poetry in English before 1931 that no other shelf held: de Slane's Ibn Khallikan (4 vols, 1843-71), Sprenger's Mas'udi, Meadows of Gold (1841), Hitti's Usamah (1929) and Baladhuri part I (1916) with Murgotten's part II (1924), Chenery and Steingass's Assemblies of al-Hariri (1867, 1898), and, since round 85, Sir William Jones's Moallakat (1782), Ockley's Hai Ebn Yokdhan (1708) and Lyall's Mufaddaliyat (1918). Lane's and Burton's Arabian Nights are on their own shelves. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only; the Beirut reprints of 1964-70 are not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 71); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
